title: Meta Expects Up To $145 Billion In Capex As AI Investments Expand
hook_text: One hundred forty five billion dollars
script:
One hundred forty five billion dollars is Meta expected to spend on capital expenditures.
Third quarter earnings reports highlight how massive infrastructure expansion drives these record high technology budgets.
Heavy financial commitments build advanced data centers for complex machine learning tasks.
These infrastructure upgrades support growing operational demands across Instagram and WhatsApp.
Market analysts evaluate whether these massive investments will yield short term financial returns.
Will expanding server capacity change how digital platforms operate next year?
